visualCheck: Page one was visually inspected: the newly introduced missing-glyph boxes in the first two table rows are gone, with the Courier outlines retained. All 14 pages rendered and were compared numerically; this is not a claim that all glyphs match PDFium.
behavior: An unmapped character in a host-resolved TrueType font proceeds to bundled outline fallback instead of drawing glyph zero. Embedded fonts retain their glyph-zero outlines. The regression fixture also verifies printable-character fallback without installed-font dependencies.
limitations: Courier table pages now report missing-outline diagnostics for unsupported codes. Symbol and ZapfDingbats mapping and diagnostic precision remain in the backlog. Full PDF.js counts belong to the earlier immutable build in pdfjs-courier-1.9.0.json; they are not updated by this focused check. Single-file timings do not prove throughput.
